name: Bilgah
overview: Bilgah is identified in Scripture as a priest and one of the chiefs of the priestly shifts serving in the temple, highlighting his role in the organized sacerdotal courses. The references in Nehemiah 10:8, 12:5, and 12:18 associate Bilgah closely with other priests such as Maaziah and Shemaiah, underscoring his leadership within the priestly community. The possibility that Bilgah is identical with Bilgai further connects these figures as key temple ministers entrusted with maintaining worship and religious order.
